description: A live-preview Markdown editor that never rewrites your source: paste images directly, tune fonts freely
config.image.path:
Where pasted / dropped images are saved. Relative paths are resolved against the current `.md` folder; paths starting with `${workspaceFolder}` or absolute paths are used as is.

Variables: `${workspaceFolder}` `${fileDir}` `${fileName}` (no extension) `${date}` (YYYYMMDD) `${time}` (HHmmss) `${timestamp}` `${uuid}` `${ext}` `${originalName}`
config.image.linkStyle: How inserted image links are written
config.image.linkStyle.relative: Relative to the current file, e.g. `assets/a.png`
config.image.linkStyle.workspaceRoot: Relative to the workspace root with a leading `/`, e.g. `/assets/a.png` (common for static sites)
config.image.downloadRemote: When pasting images from web pages, download them instead of linking to the remote URL
config.font.size: Body text size in px. `0` follows `editor.fontSize`
config.font.family: Body font: `sans`, `serif`, `mono`, `editor` (follow the editor font), or a font stack such as `"LXGW WenKai", serif`
config.font.headingFamily: Heading font; empty uses the body font
config.layout.maxWidth: Maximum text width in px; `0` fills the editor
config.layout.paragraphSpacing: Height of blank lines between paragraphs (em)
config.export.browserPath: Path to a Chrome / Edge executable for PDF export; empty searches automatically
config.defaultMode: Mode used when a Markdown file is opened
config.stats.enabled: Show Markdown word count in the status bar (words, characters, speaking and reading time)
config.stats.speakingRate: Speaking rate: CJK characters per minute
config.stats.speakingWordsPerMinute: Speaking rate: English words per minute
config.stats.readingRate: Reading speed: CJK characters per minute
config.stats.readingWordsPerMinute: Reading speed: English words per minute
config.stats.platforms: Platform length limits. `unit`: `chars` (no spaces), `words`, or `x` (X / Twitter weighting, CJK counts as 2)
